author: jsign
content: Did a quick exploration of hte cost of adding proof of posession for the system contract (i.e. as a wrapper that verifies the calldata signature an DELEGATECALL to the bytecode defined in the eip): https://github.com/leanEthereum/leanVM/pull/750

author: jtraglia
content: That doesn't sound so bad to me, even at 5 gwei.

author: m.kalinin
content:
Does the DELEGATECALL allow to switch from one signature schema to another? I guess we will have to make a change to the system contract in this case anyway (or to the delegate contract).

If we aren't planning to change our signature schema in the future then this might be a good solution for the PQ deposit contract. 

But for preregistration there is a chance that we will have to change the signature schema and ask already pre-registered validators to preregister again; and if we had proof of possession it would mean updating the contract too. I would avoid committing to a certain sig schema for preregistration

author: potuz
content: So what's the cost for a pool with 10% of the total stake more or less?

author: potuz
content: the good thing is that this doesn't touch the CL state so it's an EL problem 🙂

author: jtraglia
content: It depends on how much they've consolidated! About 2k 2048 ETH validators would represent 10% of stake. So about $2k to register if the gas price is about 1-2 gwei. Or 64x that ($128k) if you have a bunch of 32 ETH validators.
